name: Blackwood Den
summary: Blackwood Den lies under the Blackwood furbolgs’ corruption in southern Darkshore, near Ashenvale. The cave and camps that were once their peaceful home have fallen into madness. Volcor, a night elf scout, is trapped in the cavern and awaits aid from Auberdine.

sections.title: A Corrupted Stronghold
sections.body: Blackwood furbolgs hold a rocky cave and crude camps near the southern border of Darkshore and Ashenvale. Corruption has taken hold of the tribe, and its members attack outsiders. Deep inside the cave, the night elf Volcor is pinned down and in danger. Scouts and travelers from Auberdine are needed to help him.

faq.answer: Blackwood Den is a furbolg settlement and cave complex in far southern Darkshore, near Ashenvale. The corrupted Blackwood tribe makes its home there.

faq.q: Who is inside the cave at Blackwood Den?
aliases: who is trapped in the cave
faq.answer: Volcor, a night elf, is trapped inside the cave behind enemy lines. Travelers who find him must work with allies in Auberdine to help him escape the den safely.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?
faq.answer: The Blackwood furbolgs are hostile because corruption spreading across Darkshore and Kalimdor after the Third War has driven them mad. They attack outsiders on sight.

angles.text: For the night elves of Auberdine, the Blackwood tribe's corruption is a tragedy. Rescuing Volcor is an urgent duty to protect their people along the southern road.
As a druid, you may mourn the furbolgs, once steadfast protectors of the wilderness. The madness at Blackwood Den is another painful sign of Kalimdor's tainted nature.
